opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions max £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections max £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications max £5,000; Long-Term Research grants max £20,000; Research and Travel grants max £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating for at least 12 months) for New Projects, Acquisitions, Conferences, and Long-Term Research categories; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for the Research and Travel category. Not open to individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding the appreciation of sculpture. Categories cover exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, conferences, publications, long-term research, and research/travel. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, rest of world up to £1,000; plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire for the duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and researchers working on historic and contemporary sculpture. Senior Fellowships (six weeks) for established scholars. Fellowships at Studios & Gardens restricted to projects related to Henry Moore.
opportunities.summary: Month-long research fellowships at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, enabling artists and researchers to develop their work using the Research Library, Archive of Sculptors' Papers and sculpture collections. Applications closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize for BA dissertation and £250 cash prize for MA dissertation; plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50, copies of dissertations added to the Research Library, and publication of abstracts

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines, for a dissertation submitted within the past academic year at a UK university, relating directly to sculpture.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. The 2025 prize closed; submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
